title: The Rabbit and the Terrapin
moral: Do not follow sweet words right away. When things are hard, stay calm and think.
notes: 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). 기획 PLAN.md, 놀이판 11장 → 읽기 12장(11장 끝 용궁을 따로 셈). 조작·배움 놀이를 뺐다: 2장 바다·뭍 가르기(안내·오답 줄), 3~4장 방향 고르기 안내 셋과 오답 줄, 6장 자라 등 톡 안내, 8장 얼굴 카드 안내·오답 줄, 10장 토끼 톡 안내. 고르기·톡은 저절로 정답대로 진행한다(가르기는 자라, 길은 정답 길, 얼굴은 놀란 얼굴 — 얼굴 카드 없이 컷으로 바로). 간은 원작 그대로 말하고 그림은 순화(칼·피 없음). src: reuse = 놀이판 줄 그대로(녹음 공유), new = 새 내레이터 줄(녹음 필요). 새 줄은 모두 nar, 의성어·의태어를 넣었다. 교훈은 마지막 장면 마지막 줄로 이야기 말투로 한 번 읽는다(READ_MODE §3-5). 용왕(king)은 Typecast(tc) 배역이라 새 대사를 주지 않았다.

acts.set:<chamber|hall|shore|fork1|meetClose|: 장면 배치(놀이판 LAY 그대로). 첫 장면 chamber 에서 여는 음악
acts.beat:<이름>[:인자][:인자]: 놀이판과 같은 연출 조각(byeoljubu.js 의 B). 예: beat:goPath:left:600 = 정답 길을 따라 걸어감, beat:toFork2 = 숲 ②로 카메라 이동, beat:toDive = 바다 속 세트

lines.text: 깊고 깊은 바다 밑에 용궁이 있어요.
lines.en: Deep, deep under the sea, there is a sea palace.
segs: Deep, deep under the sea, there is a sea palace.

lines.text: 산호 기둥 사이로 물방울이 보글보글 올라가요.
lines.en: Little bubbles float up, blub, blub, between the coral pillars.
segs: Little bubbles float up, blub, blub, between the coral pillars.

lines.text: 용왕님이 병이 났어요. 콜록, 콜록.
lines.en: The Dragon King is sick. Cough, cough.
segs: The Dragon King is sick. Cough, cough.

lines.text: 아이고, 온몸이 아프구나.
lines.en: Oh dear, my whole body aches.
segs: Oh dear, my whole body aches.

lines.text: 잉어 의원이 약탕기를 들고 곰곰이 생각했어요.
lines.en: The carp doctor held his medicine pot and thought very hard.
segs: The carp doctor held his medicine pot and thought very hard.

lines.text: 뭍에 사는 토끼의 간을 드시면 나아요.
lines.en: If you eat the liver of a rabbit that lives on land, you will get better.
segs: If you eat the liver of a rabbit that lives on land, you will get better.

lines.text: 용왕님은 신하들을 모두 큰 방으로 불렀어요.
lines.en: The Dragon King called all his courtiers into the great hall.
segs: The Dragon King called all his courtiers into the great hall.

lines.text: 누가 토끼 간을 가져오겠느냐?
lines.en: Who will bring me a rabbit's liver?
segs: Who will bring me a rabbit's liver?

lines.text: 제가요! 다리가 여덟이니 제일 빨라요!
lines.en: Me! I have eight legs, so I am the fastest!
segs: Me! I have eight legs, so I am the fastest!

lines.text: 문어님, 뭍에서는 다리가 미끌미끌해서 못 걸어요.
lines.en: Mr. Octopus, on land your legs are too slippery to walk.
segs: Mr. Octopus, on land your legs are too slippery to walk.

lines.text: 걸을 수 있다니까!
lines.en: I can too walk!

lines.text: 문어는 먹물 속에서 뻐끔뻐끔. 물고기들은 뭍에 가면 숨을 못 쉬어요.
lines.en: The octopus puffs and puffs inside his ink cloud. And fish cannot breathe on land.
segs: The octopus puffs and puffs inside his ink cloud. And fish cannot breathe on land.

lines.text: 신하들 가운데 물에서도 뭍에서도 걸을 수 있는 건 자라뿐이었어요.
lines.en: Of all the courtiers, only the terrapin could walk both in the water and on land.
segs: Of all the courtiers, only the terrapin could walk both in the water and on land.

lines.text: 저는 물에서도 뭍에서도 걸을 수 있어요.
lines.en: I can walk in the water and on land.
segs: I can walk in the water and on land.

lines.text: 자라가 가거라. 화공은 토끼를 그려 주어라.
lines.en: Terrapin, you go. Painter, draw a rabbit for him.
segs: Terrapin, you go. Painter, draw a rabbit for him.

lines.text: 화공이 토끼 그림을 그렸어요. 귀는 길쭉, 꼬리는 짧게.
lines.en: The painter drew a rabbit. Long ears, and a short tail.
segs: The painter drew a rabbit. Long ears, and a short tail.

lines.text: 이 그림을 들고 토끼를 찾겠습니다!
lines.en: I will take this picture and find the rabbit!
segs: I will take this picture and find the rabbit!

lines.text: 자라는 바다 위로 올라왔어요. 햇빛이 눈부셔요.
lines.en: The terrapin came up out of the sea. The sunlight is dazzling.
segs: The terrapin came up out of the sea. The sunlight is dazzling.

lines.text: 뭍은 이렇게 환하구나!
lines.en: The land is so bright!

lines.text: 처음 보는 뭍에서 자라는 두리번두리번 길을 찾았어요.
lines.en: On this new land, the terrapin looked this way and that for the path.
segs: On this new land, the terrapin looked this way and that for the path.

lines.text: 갈매기님, 이 동물 어디 있소?
lines.en: Mr. Seagull, where is this animal?
segs: Mr. Seagull, where is this animal?

lines.text: 토끼네! 저 산에 살아. 왼쪽으로 가시오.
lines.en: That is a rabbit! It lives on that mountain. Go left.
segs: That is a rabbit! It lives on that mountain. Go left.

lines.text: 왼쪽, 왼쪽.
lines.en: Left, left.

lines.text: 자라는 엉금엉금 산으로 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The terrapin crawled slowly, slowly up the mountain.
segs: The terrapin crawled slowly, slowly up the mountain.

lines.text: 다람쥐님, 이 동물 어디 있소?
lines.en: Miss Squirrel, where is this animal?
segs: Miss Squirrel, where is this animal?

lines.text: 토끼? 오른쪽으로 가시오.
lines.en: A rabbit? Go right.

lines.text: 자라는 오른쪽 길로 숲 속 깊이 들어갔어요.
lines.en: The terrapin took the path on the right, deep into the forest.
segs: The terrapin took the path on the right, deep into the forest.

lines.text: 멧돼지님, 이 동물 어디 있소?
lines.en: Mr. Boar, where is this animal?
segs: Mr. Boar, where is this animal?

lines.text: 토끼는 저 바위 뒤에. 가운데로 가시오.
lines.en: The rabbit is behind that rock. Go straight up the middle.
segs: The rabbit is behind that rock. Go straight up the middle.

lines.text: 가운데 길 끝, 커다란 바위 뒤에서 무언가 바스락거렸어요.
lines.en: At the end of the middle path, something rustled behind a big rock.
segs: At the end of the middle path, something rustled behind a big rock.

lines.text: 누가 나를 찾아?
lines.en: Who is looking for me?

lines.text: 귀는 길쭉, 꼬리는 짧고… 똑같다! 토끼님이구나.
lines.en: Long ears, a short tail... the same! You are the rabbit.
segs: Long ears, a short tail... the same! You are the rabbit.

lines.text: 자라는 공손하게 인사하고 달콤한 말을 꺼냈어요.
lines.en: The terrapin bowed politely and began to say sweet things.
segs: The terrapin bowed politely and began to say sweet things.

lines.text: 토끼님, 용궁에 가면 높은 벼슬을 드려요.
lines.en: Mr. Rabbit, come to the sea palace and you will get a high post.
segs: Mr. Rabbit, come to the sea palace and you will get a high post.

lines.text: 맛있는 것도 잔뜩 있어요.
lines.en: And there are lots of tasty treats.
segs: And there are lots of tasty treats.

lines.text: 토끼는 벼슬 모자와 떡을 떠올리며 싱글벙글 웃었어요.
lines.en: The rabbit pictured a fine official's hat and rice cakes, and grinned and grinned.
segs: The rabbit pictured a fine official's hat and rice cakes, and grinned and grinned.

lines.text: 벼슬? 맛있는 것? 좋아, 갈래!
lines.en: A high post? Tasty treats? Yes, I will go!
segs: A high post? Tasty treats? Yes, I will go!

lines.text: 토끼는 덥석 따라나섰어요. 좋은 것만 생각했거든요.
lines.en: The rabbit followed right away. He only thought about the good things.
segs: The rabbit followed right away. He only thought about the good things.

lines.text: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 질 무렵, 둘은 바닷가에 닿았어요.
lines.en: As the sun was setting, the two of them reached the seashore.
segs: As the sun was setting, the two of them reached the seashore.

lines.text: 제 등에 타세요. 꼭 잡으세요!
lines.en: Climb on my back. Hold on tight!
segs: Climb on my back. Hold on tight!

lines.text: 토끼가 자라 등에 올라 등딱지를 꼭 잡자, 풍덩!
lines.en: The rabbit climbed onto the terrapin's back and held on tight. Splash!
segs: The rabbit climbed onto the terrapin's back and held on tight. Splash!

lines.text: 자라는 토끼를 업고 바다 속으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: The terrapin carried the rabbit down into the sea.
segs: The terrapin carried the rabbit down into the sea.

lines.text: 물고기 떼가 반짝반짝 지나가고, 미역이 살랑살랑 흔들렸어요.
lines.en: Shiny fish swam by, and the seaweed swayed, swish, swish.
segs: Shiny fish swam by, and the seaweed swayed, swish, swish.

lines.text: 우와, 물고기다! 바다 속은 파랗구나.
lines.en: Wow, fish! It is so blue under the sea.
segs: Wow, fish! It is so blue under the sea.

lines.text: 용궁에 다 왔어요. 문이 차례로 열려요.
lines.en: Here is the sea palace. The doors open, one by one.
segs: Here is the sea palace. The doors open, one by one.

lines.text: 어서 오세요!
lines.en: Welcome!

lines.text: 자라와 토끼는 둘째 문, 셋째 문을 지나 안으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: The terrapin and the rabbit went through the second door and the third door.
segs: The terrapin and the rabbit went through the second door and the third door.

lines.text: 우와, 진주랑 산호가 반짝반짝!
lines.en: Wow, pearls and coral, all sparkly!
segs: Wow, pearls and coral, all sparkly!

lines.text: 자, 용왕님께 가요.
lines.en: Now, let us go to the Dragon King.
segs: Now, let us go to the Dragon King.

lines.text: 커다란 옥좌에 앉은 용왕님이 토끼를 내려다보았어요.
lines.en: The Dragon King, on his great throne, looked down at the rabbit.
segs: The Dragon King, on his great throne, looked down at the rabbit.

lines.text: 토끼야, 잘 왔다. 너의 간을 다오.
lines.en: Rabbit, welcome. Give me your liver.
segs: Rabbit, welcome. Give me your liver.

lines.text: 토끼는 깜짝 놀라 뒤로 벌러덩 넘어졌어요.
lines.en: The rabbit was so surprised, he fell right over backwards.
segs: The rabbit was so surprised, he fell right over backwards.

lines.text: 네?! 제 간을요?
lines.en: What?! My liver?

lines.text: 토끼는 그제야 알았어요. 자라가 거짓말을 한 거예요.
lines.en: Only then did the rabbit understand. The terrapin had told a lie.
segs: Only then did the rabbit understand. The terrapin had told a lie.

lines.text: 어떡하지… 겁먹지 말고 생각하자.
lines.en: What do I do... Do not be scared. Think.
segs: What do I do... Do not be scared. Think.

lines.text: 용왕님, 저는 간을 꺼내서 산속 바위에 널어 두고 왔어요.
lines.en: Your Majesty, I took my liver out and left it drying on a rock in the mountains.
segs: Your Majesty, I took my liver out and left it drying on a rock in the mountains.

lines.text: 자라님이 미리 말을 안 해 줬어요. 가서 가져올게요!
lines.en: The terrapin did not tell me before. I will go and get it!
segs: The terrapin did not tell me before. I will go and get it!

lines.text: 그래? 그럼 얼른 가져오너라.
lines.en: Is that so? Then go and bring it quickly.
segs: Is that so? Then go and bring it quickly.

lines.text: 용왕님은 토끼 말을 믿었어요.
lines.en: The Dragon King believed the rabbit.
segs: The Dragon King believed the rabbit.

lines.text: 토끼는 속으로 휴, 하고 숨을 내쉬었어요.
lines.en: Inside, the rabbit let out a quiet sigh of relief.
segs: Inside, the rabbit let out a quiet sigh of relief.

lines.text: 제가 모시고 다녀오겠습니다.
lines.en: I will take him there and back.
segs: I will take him there and back.

lines.text: 자라는 토끼를 업고 다시 뭍으로 갔어요.
lines.en: The terrapin carried the rabbit back to land.
segs: The terrapin carried the rabbit back to land.

lines.text: 바위 위에 올라선 토끼가 자라를 내려다보며 웃었어요.
lines.en: Standing on top of a rock, the rabbit looked down at the terrapin and laughed.
segs: Standing on top of a rock, the rabbit looked down at the terrapin and laughed.

lines.text: 자라님, 간을 꺼내 놓고 다니는 동물이 어디 있어요? 하하!
lines.en: Mr. Terrapin, what animal takes its liver out and leaves it behind? Ha ha!
segs: Mr. Terrapin, what animal takes its liver out and leaves it behind? Ha ha!

lines.text: 이제 달콤한 말엔 안 속을 거야!
lines.en: I will never be fooled by sweet words again!
segs: I will never be fooled by sweet words again!

lines.text: 아이고… 속았구나.
lines.en: Oh dear... I was tricked.

lines.text: 안녕!
lines.en: Bye-bye!

lines.text: 토끼는 숲으로 깡충깡충 달아났어요.
lines.en: The rabbit hopped away, hop, hop, into the forest.
segs: The rabbit hopped away, hop, hop, into the forest.

lines.text: 자라는 바닷가에 엎드려 한숨을 쉬었어요.
lines.en: The terrapin lay down on the beach and sighed.
segs: The terrapin lay down on the beach and sighed.

lines.text: 용왕님께 뭐라고 하지…
lines.en: What will I tell the Dragon King...
segs: What will I tell the Dragon King...

lines.text: 그때, 산신령이 나타났어요.
lines.en: Just then, the mountain spirit appeared.
segs: Just then, the mountain spirit appeared.

lines.text: 자라야, 애쓴 마음이 갸륵하구나. 이 약을 용왕님께 드려라.
lines.en: Terrapin, you tried so hard for your king. Take this medicine to the Dragon King.
segs: Terrapin, you tried so hard for your king. Take this medicine to the Dragon King.

lines.text: 고맙습니다, 산신령님!
lines.en: Thank you, mountain spirit!

lines.text: 자라는 약을 안고 바다로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: The terrapin hugged the medicine and went back to the sea.
segs: The terrapin hugged the medicine and went back to the sea.

lines.text: 자라는 용궁으로 돌아와 용왕님께 약을 드렸어요.
lines.en: The terrapin came back to the sea palace and gave the medicine to the Dragon King.
segs: The terrapin came back to the sea palace and gave the medicine to the Dragon King.

lines.text: 아, 이제 다 나았다!
lines.en: Ah, now I am all better!
segs: Ah, now I am all better!

lines.text: 용궁에 웃음이 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: Laughter came back to the sea palace.
segs: Laughter came back to the sea palace.

lines.text: 달콤한 말에 덥석 따라가지 않고, 어려울 땐 차분히 생각하면 돼요.
lines.en: Do not follow sweet words right away, and when things are hard, stay calm and think.
segs: Do not follow sweet words right away, and when things are hard, stay calm and think.
